properties_list.title: Premium Arabica Coffee Estate
properties_list.description: This organic estate is located in Coorg's high coffee zone. It includes Arabica crop lines interlocked with premium black pepper vines, gravitational water systems, and a classic heritage bungalow.

properties_list.title: Misty Valleys Luxury Villa
properties_list.description: Perched gracefully along an elevated ridge, this private luxury home hosts 270-degree panorama views of mountain valleys. Equipped with thermal glass panels, infinity pool, and custom furnishings.

properties_list.title: The Heights Modern Sky-Penthouse
properties_list.description: Spacious design at the top of Bangalore's notable luxury towers. Features structural marble, German home systems, comprehensive wardrobes, and private lakeview terraces.
